<issue>
Conditional simplification not working for IF and CASE expressions

#### Description

The optimizer's conditional simplification appears to have stopped working. IF and CASE expressions with statically known conditions are no longer being simplified to their appropriate branches.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import sqlglot
from sqlglot import optimize

# Test IF expression with always true condition
sql = "SELECT IF(TRUE, 'yes', 'no')"
result = optimize(sql)
print(f"Input:  {sql}")
print(f"Output: {result}")
# Expected: SELECT 'yes'
# Actual: SELECT IF(TRUE, 'yes', 'no')

# Test CASE expression with always true condition  
sql = "SELECT CASE WHEN TRUE THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END"
result = optimize(sql)
print(f"Input:  {sql}")
print(f"Output: {result}")
# Expected: SELECT 'yes'
# Actual: SELECT CASE WHEN TRUE THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END

# Test IF expression with always false condition
sql = "SELECT IF(FALSE, 'yes', 'no')"
result = optimize(sql)
print(f"Input:  {sql}")
print(f"Output: {result}")
# Expected: SELECT 'no'
# Actual: SELECT IF(FALSE, 'yes', 'no')
```

The conditional expressions are not being simplified even when their conditions can be statically determined to be always true or always false.
</issue>
